title: @c15t/browser: Cookie banner and cookie consent for any website, with one script tag
description: Cookie banner, preference center, and consent-gated scripts for sites without a build step: Webflow, WordPress, Framer, Squarespace, and plain HTML. Configure consent policies for GDPR and other privacy laws, then paste one script tag. Bundled apps can import the same runtime as an ES module.
features: One script tag from a CDN, configured with data attributes or calls queued on `window.c15t`
Prebuilt banner and preference dialog in a shadow root, so your site's CSS does not change them
Vendor scripts use `<script type="text/plain" data-c15t-category>` and iframes use `data-src` and `data-category`. They load when the resolved policy allows their categories
Buttons with `data-c15t-action` and links to `#c15t-preferences` work without code
A headless build with the same runtime and `window.c15t` API, for your own banner
DevTools (`c15t.devtools.js`) and IAB GPP (`c15t.gpp.js`) load as a second tag. For IAB TCF 2.4, load `c15t.iab.js` instead of `c15t.js`
ES module entry points for bundled apps, which can use the @c15t/integrations vendor loaders
prerequisites: A page where you can add a `<script>` tag
An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or offline mode for local development
manualInstallation: Paste before `</head>`, with the backend URL from your Inth project:

A URL without a version loads the newest release, so pin an exact version, such as `@c15t/browser@3.0.0`, in production. The default `c15t.js` requires a backend URL. Load `dist/c15t.offline.js` for offline mode or `dist/c15t.headless.js` for the runtime without any UI.
usage: Add the tag and reload. The banner appears when the visitor's policy asks for one
Change vendor tags to `type="text/plain"` with `data-c15t-category="measurement"` so they load when the resolved policy allows that category
Link to `#c15t-preferences` so visitors can reopen the preference dialog
For every attribute and method, see the [HTML docs](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/html/attributes-and-api)

customSections.Which Script to Load:
| File | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `c15t.js` | Inth or a self-hosted backend. Set `data-backend-url`. A self-hosted backend also serves a preconfigured script at `/c15t.js` |
| `c15t.offline.js` | Offline mode: choices stay in the browser, with local policy rules |
| `c15t.headless.js` | The runtime without UI, for your own banner. Can inline or fetch the backend's cacheable `/manifest` |
| `c15t.iab.js` | IAB TCF 2.4. Configure `iab` with your registered CMP ID and vendor list. See the [IAB example](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/html/iab) |
| `c15t.devtools.js` | A DevTools panel, with a Location tab to try policies by region |
| `c15t.gpp.js` | IAB GPP (`__gpp`) for US state opt-outs. Also available as `mountGPP` from `@c15t/browser/gpp` |
